author: jpep
content:
hello! im a sunshine speedrunner and theres a couple question i was hoping you guys might be able to help answer since you know so much about the technical aspects of the game. Those are things where we have an idea of the way they generally work, but **precise** knowledge would potentially help shave some time off :) please say so if i should ask elsewhere - i tried the sunshine hacking server already with little luck 😬 

1) It's been observed that cannon moles in Pinna 2 and Noki 1 behave kind of weirdly. Notably, the pinna 2 mole's hitbox disappears at seemingly inconsistent times - if you try to enter the cannon as fast as possible as the TAS does, most of the time you will take damage, but sometimes you will be let through for seemingly no reason. Any idea why that could be? 

For the Noki 1 mole, we've noticed that there are seemingly 2 "ranges" where it will start throwing bombs - a faster, closer one, and a large, slower one. Is it known if this is just based on distance? 

2) What exactly triggers the Pinna 4 turtles to attack (i.e, jump at) Mario? The general consensus is that you need to get close to one, then get further away from it to trigger a jump, but this is not really consistent in practice (for instance, some may attack immediately upon getting close to a not-moving Mario). 

3) Are the pinna 3 grate electro-koopas inactive while off-screen? It seems like they do not move when they are not on camera, but that knowledge is a bit wonky and seems to be version dependant - executing the same movements on PAL vs NSTC-J will not result in the same Koopa layout at the end, for instance. 

4) Do polluted piranhas open their mouth faster if they have to turn to face Mario? (this is probably just confirmation bias)

5) In Ricco 6, the green blooper used in the speedrun can either start off at a slow speed, then accelerate, or already be at max speed from the start. This seems to depend on Mario's position when he gets on the blooper. Any idea why that is?
